content.text: Co-sleeping is really common at Milo's age, and at 5 he can handle a gradual move. Start with a sleep-alone bridge. Do the usual bedtime routine in his own room and stay until he's drowsy. Tell him ahead of time that you'll sit by the bed and then go. Once that feels normal, move your chair a bit closer to the door every couple of nights. A small reward chart for staying in his own bed can help a kid this age feel like it's his win.
